append_sources.title: Maximilian Hanusch, A Ck-Seeley-Extension-Theorem for Bastiani’s Differential Calculus, arXiv:2002.05125v2 (23 February 2023)
append_sources.locator: Bounded passages personally read in the retrieved 29-page full PDF: Theorem1 pp10–11 and remarks pp11–12; construction(24)–(26) and sections4.1–4.2 pp19–22; Lemma6 derivative matching pp23–25. No whole-paper or original Seeley1964 reading claimed.

contents.name: Theorem1 pp10–11: linear half-space extensions preserving all extended boundary differentials, with parameters and continuity estimates
contents.support: The local finite-dimensional supplier constructs a fixed spatial extension treating time as an unchanged parameter; it preserves every boundary jet and gives compact-time seminorm bounds. No infinite-dimensional Bastiani theorem is claimed.

contents.name: Construction(24)–(26) p19: smooth normal cutoff and fixed coefficients with every moment and weighted absolute summability
contents.support: The source attributes moment-coefficient existence to Seeley. The new local proof independently constructs a_k from finite interpolation at b_k=−2^k, proves the uniform Gaussian bound and all moments; it does not adopt the source attribution as an accepted prerequisite.

contents.name: Section4.2 pp21–22, Lemma5: locally finite reflected sums away from the boundary
contents.support: The fixed normal-cutoff reflection formula is locally finite for each outside point and is then glued through finitely many smooth spatial boundary charts with time-independent cutoffs.

contents.name: Lemma6 pp23–25: uniform tail bounds and finite-head limits match every boundary differential
contents.support: The local proof supplies the complete scalar mixed-derivative version with the exact coefficient moments, compact-time bounds and coordinate-FTC gluing into one actual joint C-infinity neighbourhood extension.

contents.name: Theorem1 general infinite-dimensional and finite-Ck Bastiani scope, pp10–12
contents.reason: Only a fixed bounded smooth domain in R3 with finitely many real components and an ordinary real time parameter supplies a prerequisite of this run. General locally convex targets, infinite-dimensional Bastiani calculus and arbitrary finite-Ck extension systems are not added to the approved scope.

local_retrieval_evidence.method: Successful urllib full-PDF retrieval; fitz text extraction; no native source-fetch-check stamp is invented.

append_canonical.name: Local interpolation proof of the Seeley coefficients and every moment for the fixed spatial parameter-preserving extension
append_canonical.support: This is a canonical local adaptation: finite Lagrange polynomials, the published real-polynomial root bound, uniform 576 times Gaussian coefficient bounds, monotone coefficient limits and uniformly summable tails prove all moments explicitly. It is not a numbered Hanusch/Seeley theorem credited as read.

append_canonical.name: Local parameter-dependent Dirichlet and compatible normalized Neumann Poisson families with actual joint neighbourhood extension
append_canonical.support: The exact weak Dirichlet/Neumann suppliers, fixed boundary lifts, declared smooth-domain Sobolev extension theorem and Dirichlet higher-order estimates supply the stated branches. The genuinely additional natural-Neumann H2/higher-order estimate is derived explicitly with scalar-L2/vector-H1 quotient sources, flux commutators, normal recovery and finite-cover induction; it is not attributed to the Dirichlet-only published theorem. The fixed Seeley supplier then gives the common ambient smooth family.
